description: This file defines the ValueStateClient class for managing state in Spark Structured Streaming, including methods to check existence, get, update, and clear state, utilizing protobuf messages and a client API.

classes.name: ValueStateClient
classes.description: Client class for managing value-based state in Spark Structured Streaming, providing methods to check existence, retrieve, update, and clear state entries.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ValueStateClient with a client API and schema, parsing the schema if provided as a string.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a state variable with the given name exists, returning True or False.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a state variable by name, returning a tuple or None.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the value of a state variable with the provided tuple.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the state variable with the specified name.
